schema_notes: PhotoGIMP user-defined actions. GIMP never writes this file: it is the source of truth, safe to hand-edit, version, back up, and share. The photogimp-actions plug-in reads it at GIMP startup and registers one GIMP procedure per action, named photogimp-<id>, at the menu path given. That procedure can then be bound to any shortcut key like any built-in action; scripts/sync-actions.py writes the shortcut below into shortcutsrc. Steps run in order inside one undo group. Step args use $ references: $image (the active image), $drawables (the active drawables, a list), $name (a previous step's result, bound with "result"), $name[N] (Nth item of a list result). Anything else is a literal (string, number, true/false). Step argument names must match the PDB procedure's own argument names exactly (check them in GIMP's Procedure Browser if a step fails). After editing this file, re-run scripts/sync-actions.py and restart GIMP.
